derivation: SCOPE: declaration A-C16 of the champion gate. It covers only R1-C at W = 16, the gate's constructor-world mode (--constructor-roster, report mode CONSTRUCTOR_ROOTS) at R1's settings (--depth 2 --k-own 9 --k-opp 9 --k1-own 9 --k1-opp 9 --block-invariance) and declaration A's harness (--fixed-shapes --capacity 512 --block-lanes 2187 --oracle-chunk 512, which the mode requires), with W = 16 worlds per root (K = 8 requests of two worlds) and constructor seed 20261103: the world budget of the live evaluation. R1-C at W = 8 is A-C's (champion-9375-bf16-r1c-20261108.json), and the gate refuses either declaration at the other W. R1, R2 and R3 are not covered here: A and B cover them. ROOTS (the gate's CONSTRUCTOR_RULE): one roster, Codex's old-bank roster (final tail, 95.5% full construction), never pooled with another, pinned by sha256 (--constructor-roster PATH SHA; recorded in the run header's constructor_roots section) and read as scripts/phase_d_constructor_coverage.py reads it. Per turn band (turns 1-3, 4-9, 10-19, 20+), in roster order, the first 10 roots that ProtocolConstructor.prepare fully constructs. Then, for each of forced_switch, sleep, fresh_substitute and wish absent from those 40 (classified by depthn_live_search.classify), the first fully constructing root of that class in roster order, at most one per class. Refused roots are listed and never priced, and a band short of 10 fails the run closed. NUMBERS: declaration A's, unchanged and not re-measured: value_bound 0.032, turn1_logit_bound 0.63, root_logit_bound 0.26, deeper_logit_bound 0.87, near_tie_q_bound 0.032. The evaluator identity and the source measurement are A's (champion-9375-bf16-r1r3-20261107.json, the same sha256), and so is the construction: each field = 1.25 x its largest site tail. SITES: R1-C's gated float sites are R1's minus R1.b.*, because (b) is NOT_APPLICABLE on constructor worlds (D3's FramePricer has no input for pre-built worlds). Each remaining site is in A's site table with its covering field and tail: R1.c.t1_value_head -> value_bound 0.01986; R1.c.t1_own_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.5019; R1.c.t1_peer_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.4124; R1.c.root_peer_logits -> root_logit_bound 0.2076; R1.c.leaf_value -> value_bound 0.02055; R1.c.depth2_pass_t1_value -> value_bound 0.01986; R1.c.depth2_pass_t1_own_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.5019; R1.c.depth2_pass_t1_peer_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.4124; R1.c.depth2_pass_root_peer_logits -> root_logit_bound 0.2076; R1.c.depth2_pass_t2_value -> value_bound 0.02055; R1.e.max_abs_delta_q -> near_tie_q_bound 0.02158; R1.f.max_abs_delta_child_value -> value_bound 0.02055; R1.f.max_abs_delta_row_q -> value_bound 0.02055; R1.block_invariance.leaf_value -> value_bound 0.02055; R1.block_invariance.root_peer_logits -> root_logit_bound 0.2076; R1.block_invariance.t1_own_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.5019; R1.block_invariance.t1_peer_logits -> turn1_logit_bound 0.4124; R1.block_invariance.t1_value -> value_bound 0.01986. There is no new float site, so nothing goes to report-only. The mode's averaging_argmax check adds no number: it reads all 16 worlds of a root, and averaging's q is still the mean of the 8 blocks' completed-Q, so it gates at 2 x (e)'s q_noise_bound (here near_tie_q_bound), a bound derived from (e)'s. deeper_logit_bound is never applied at depth 2. TRANSFER, for the same reason as A-C's: A's tails measure bf16 against f32 for the same champion, view and executor under the same harness; only the input distribution changes, from D3 bank worlds to constructor worlds of captured Showdown roots. W = 16 changes only how many worlds, and so how many blocks of two, each root has: every gated site still compares one block's two worlds per request at the same positions, and A-C's sites, tails and construction carry over unchanged. On R1 the gate's actual differences sat far inside A's bounds: (c) values at most 3e-7 and logits at most 1.9e-5, at most 3e-5 of A's bounds. The only material site was R1.b.root_peer_logits, at 0.08 of its bound, and it drops out here. depth2_pass_t1_value is 0 by construction, because the pass and the depth-2 frame are one program. NUMERICS: the certified runs used JAX_DEFAULT_MATMUL_PRECISION=highest and JAX_ENABLE_X64=0 from the run environment. The gate never sets them; the R1-C header records the effective jax_default_matmul_precision. GUARD: GUARD_DECLARED_RULE, as in A. Pre-stated: an R1-C FAIL at W = 16 is recorded as FAIL. A-C16 is not re-derived after a result.
